venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Rainy, light drizzle; pouring at the end
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 10/21 (MOD/Chef Gigi & Saleh/Kevin; entered by Gigi; posted 1:28am 10/22).** Net $5,500 vs $4,361 target (+26%). Food $1,328 (all Marquee; Standing Room $0). Comps $121 (DNLs, small gifts). 126 guests, $111.93 check avg. Busy start to a rainy night with large groups and many walk-ins in the first 2 hours; food flew out of the kitchen 6-8pm. Lull around 9pm that never picked up; no waitlist, every group seated. Floor cut around midnight, room cleared shortly after 1am. Maintenance: grease trap serviced, hot water tank deep cleaned, water heater status pending. 86: 4ct oysters; ran out of aged cheese (restocked). No-shows charged. No incidents.
